title: China first “frozen person”
simplified_paragraphs: 八年前， 桂军民的妻子展文莲因为肺癌即将去世。 但在她去世前， 桂军民做了一个特别的决定： 将她的身体冷冻起来。 他希望未来医学进步后， 妻子能再次醒来。 于是， 展文莲成为中国第一位被冷冻的人。
她的身体被保存在一个特别的液氮罐里， 里面的温度非常低。 桂军民经常去看望这个罐子。 他觉得妻子只是“ 睡着了” ， 并不是永远离开。 这个想法帮助他度过了许多难过的日子。
不过， 时间慢慢过去， 桂军民的生活也发生了一些变化。 他变老了， 身体也不如以前好。 他也有了新的女朋友， 但他明确表示， 没有人能代替展文莲在他心里的位置。
关于冷冻技术， 目前还没有成功让人复活的例子。 科学家们说， 这还是一个需要继续研究的领域。 虽然希望很小， 但桂军民仍然愿意等待。
他计划将来自己老了也装进液氮罐冷冻保存起来， 这样如果妻子醒来， 就不会孤单。
现在， 桂军民努力在怀念妻子和面对现实之间找平衡。 他保留着妻子可能回来的希望， 同时也认真过好现在的每一天。

english_paragraphs: Eight years ago, Gui Junmin's wife Zhan Wenlian was about to die of lung cancer. But before her death, Gui Junmin made a special decision: to freeze her body. He hopes that after medical advances in the future, his wife will be able to wake up again. As a result, Zhan Wenlian became the first person in China to be frozen.

Her body was kept in a special liquid nitrogen tank at very low temperatures. Gui Junmin often visited this jar. He felt that his wife just "fell asleep" and did not leave forever. This idea helped him get through many sad days.

However, as time passed slowly, some changes took place in the lives of Guijun and civilians. He is getting older and his health is not as good as before. He also has a new girlfriend, but he made it clear that no one can replace Zhan Wenlian's place in his heart.

Regarding freezing technology, there are currently no successful examples of people being resurrected. Scientists say this is an area that requires continued research. Although there is little hope, the army and people of Guizhou are still willing to wait.
He plans to freeze him in a liquid nitrogen tank when he is old, so that if his wife wakes up, she will not be alone.
Now, Gui Junmin is trying to find a balance between missing his wife and facing reality. He retains the hope that his wife may come back, and at the same time, he also takes every day seriously.
